name: SVR Poker Android
nextApkDrop: Only after the user explicitly requests the next APK update.
notes: Phase 343 reorganizes the Android HUD into separate status, community-card, hole-card, action, raise, and movement zones.
The permanent raise controls and duplicate quick-position buttons are removed from normal gameplay view.
The raise slider opens only after the player taps RAISE.
SIT now measures the canonical table and places the camera close to the south/front seat while aiming at the felt center.
Five community-card slots display the same Phase 336 community state used by the 3D table cards.
The single MOVE stick, single LOOK stick, authoritative poker actions, Phase 341 table geometry, and Phase 342 performance governor are preserved.
Automatic update prompts remain disabled and APK installation remains manual-only.
